# PandaPath

> AI product studio in Bangalore, India. We design and ship WhatsApp AI bots, RAG knowledge systems, and full-stack AI products for Indian startups. Fixed pricing from ₹25,000, live in 2–4 weeks, direct access to the developer who builds it — no account managers or ticket queues in between.

PandaPath is a small studio, not an agency with layers. Every project is scoped at a fixed price before work starts, built by the person you talk to, and typically delivered in two to six weeks.

## Services

- [WhatsApp AI Bot](https://pandapath.in/services#whatsapp-ai-bot): Automated WhatsApp support and lead capture in Hindi and English. From ₹25,000, 2 weeks.
- [RAG Knowledge System](https://pandapath.in/services#rag-knowledge-system): Turns PDFs, Notion pages and contracts into a searchable AI assistant with cited answers. From ₹40,000, 3 weeks.
- [Full AI Product Build](https://pandapath.in/services#full-ai-product-build): End-to-end web or mobile product with AI features, deployed with CI/CD. From ₹80,000, 4–6 weeks.
- [AI Business Audit](https://pandapath.in/services#ai-business-audit): A two-hour working session identifying the top 3 places AI actually pays off in your business. ₹6,000.
